reports.title: The use of the pressure cuff test in the diagnosis of decompression sickness.
reports.locator: Rudge and Stone, Methods p. 266, Results and Table I p. 267
reports.reason: Retain the selected diagnostic archive as clinical context. The original records 310 treated DCS patients, 179 with eligible extremity pain, 87 who received the pressure-cuff test and 53 positive results in that tested subset. The source prints 89% chamber origin, 9% diving and 2% aircraft. It gives no prospective exposure denominator, settings for individual patients, or test results cross-tabulated by initiating setting. Hold linkage to other USAFSAM case archives.

reports.title: Incidencia de enfermedad descompresiva tipo II en entrenamiento hipobárico y evaluación de cámara hiperbárica monoplaza
reports.locator: Olaya Santamaria, Methods pp. 309–311, Table 2 p. 313, Figures 1–2 pp. 312 and 314, and Tables 3–4
reports.reason: Retain one Type II DCS case in 828 exposures in 2015 as reported by Table 2 and Figure 1. The prose reports zero. The table and figures reconcile with the source total 15/10,280 and are the preferred cells. Maintain the overlapping 2013–2020 published neurological margin of 14/6,754 and the previously extracted 2021–2023 margin of 1/3,526. The broader official FAC aggregate uses different outcome and exposure definitions. Exact roles, individual linkage and uniform case ascertainment window remain unavailable.
